title: Libre2 sensor dont deliver readings
symptom: Libre2 sensor does not connect to the phone via Bluetooth, and no readings are delivered. In xDrip+ system status, instead of the serial number, a MAC-like address is displayed.
cause: The thread identifies two possible causes: (1) a batch of faulty Libre 2 sensors where Bluetooth alarms are not working, so the patched app gets no data via Bluetooth; (2) possibly Android background restrictions or low battery disabling Bluetooth.
fix: For faulty sensors, Abbott replaces them. For background restrictions, allow the apps to run in the background in the auto run manager in Settings. Also ensure Bluetooth is activated, LibreLink is running in the background, and for first-time setup activate NFC, BT, location services, and an alarm in LibreLink.
settings_changed: auto run manager → allow apps to run in the background
evidence_quote: I had the same screen as above, but managed to get it working by allowing the apps to run in the background in the auto run manager in Settings.
